title: SEC7r4: no multi-chunk HMAC Update KAT in test suite
description: test_hmac_sha256() calls wc_HmacUpdate exactly once before wc_HmacFinal. The accumulation realloc path in crypto2dev_hmac() (XMALLOC + XMEMCPY of old data) is never exercised. If the realloc or XMEMCPY is wrong (e.g., due to off-by-one in dataSz arithmetic), a multi-chunk HMAC would produce a wrong MAC silently. RFC 4231 Test Case 2 (key=4a656665, data='what do ya want for nothing?' split across two updates) provides a suitable two-chunk KAT with known output.
